$comment: Live milestone state. Version-controlled so it is auditable, and updated by the AI engineer as work lands. The Control Center reads this -- it does not guess progress.
phase: Console built; connecting it to GitHub

Control Center is the only entry point (push script retired)

blockers.title: GitHub is not connected to this console
blockers.meaning: Build results and pull requests cannot be shown until a GitHub token is added. It takes about two minutes and the instructions are in the console's README. Everything on this machine still works without it.

blockers.title: Merging still happens on github.com
blockers.meaning: The console can show you that everything passed, but the approve-and-merge button is not built yet, so it links you out. That is an engineering gap, not something for you to work around.

blockers.title: The database has never been applied anywhere
blockers.meaning: Phase 2 is built and tested but not live. It needs a preview environment first, which needs Supabase branching switched on.
